sources: https://lincolnks.org/lodging-rv-park (City of Lincoln Center, read 2026-11-06): 'The City has a new RV Park located on the west end of the City Park on Lincoln Avenue. https://lincolnks.org/documents/597/Lincoln_RV_Camping_Form_Fillable_.pdf (RV camping form, created 2024-04-05, read 2026-11-06): 'To make application: Call 785-524-4280, Email: clerk@lincolnks.org'; same $20/$125/$500 fees; 'No Reservations are available, RV Park is first come, first serve.'; 'Payment is due on the day of arrival'; 'A convenience fee of 3% ... for all debit and credit card transactions'; 'All payments are NON-REFUNDABLE'.
